info.name: GIFT API
info.description:
GIFT — AI-Powered Finance Education & Investment Intelligence Platform.

Import this collection, set the `baseUrl` variable to your server URL, and run **Login** to auto-populate `{{token}}`.

Real-time Community Chat is handled via Socket.IO — see the Community folder for the REST message history endpoint.

variable.description: Server base URL. Change to your deployed URL.
JWT — auto-populated by the Login test script.

item.name: Auth
item.description: User registration, login, and optional Web3 wallet authentication.

request.description: Create a new user account. Returns a JWT on success. No auth header required.
Authenticate with email + password. Returns a JWT. The test script auto-stores the token in {{token}}.
Request a one-time nonce for the given wallet address. Sign with MetaMask, then POST to /api/auth/web3. No auth header required.
Authenticate via signed wallet nonce (MetaMask / Web3 bonus feature). Returns a JWT on success. No auth header required.

item.name: Portfolio
item.description: Manage and analyze user portfolio holdings using the C++ risk engine.

request.description:
Save or update portfolio holdings for the authenticated user.

Expected response: { message: 'Holdings saved', portfolio: { ... } }

Run full C++ risk analysis (VaR, Sharpe Ratio, Beta, Monte Carlo) on the user's portfolio. Pass an empty holdings array to use saved holdings.

Expected response: { analysis: { riskScore, varDaily, sharpeRatio, beta, suggestion, ... } }

item.name: News
item.description: Live financial news with ML-powered VADER sentiment analysis.

item.name: Prediction
item.description: Stock prediction playground — submit predictions, get AI predictions, and review history.

request.description:
Submit a user prediction for a stock ticker. The ML service generates a concurrent AI prediction and an explanation.

Expected response: { prediction: { ticker, userPrediction, aiPrediction, explanation, timestamp } }

Get the ML model's prediction for a given ticker. Replace :ticker with e.g. AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL.

Expected response: { ticker, prediction, confidence, model }

Retrieve the authenticated user's full prediction history, sorted by most recent.

Expected response: { predictions: [{ ticker, userPrediction, aiPrediction, actualOutcome, explanation, timestamp }] }

item.name: Advisor
item.description: Gemini-powered AI financial strategy advisor with context from portfolio, news, and predictions.

request.description:
Send a message to the AI advisor. The advisor has access to the user's portfolio snapshot, recent prediction history, and market news to personalize responses.

Expected response: { reply: '...', context: { portfolio: bool, news: bool, predictions: bool } }

item.name: Learning
item.description: Finance Academy — courses, lessons, quizzes, and progress tracking.

request.description:
Fetch all available courses with the authenticated user's progress merged in.

Expected response: an array of course objects at the top level — [{ _id, title, description, lessons, progressPct, quizCompleted, ... }]

Note: the array is returned directly, not wrapped in a { courses: ... } envelope.

Fetch a single course with full lesson content and the user's progress. Replace :courseId with a course ID from Get All Courses.

Expected response: { course: { _id, title, lessons: [{ id, title, content }], progressPct } }

Submit answers for a course quiz. Answers are a 0-indexed array matching question order.

Expected response: { score, total, passed, correctAnswers }

Mark a lesson as completed for the authenticated user. Idempotent — calling twice with the same lessonId has no effect.

Expected response: { message: 'Progress updated', completedLessons: [...] }

item.name: Community
item.description: Community Hub. Real-time messaging is handled via Socket.IO (send_message / new_message events). This folder exposes the REST history endpoint only.

request.description:
Fetch the last 100 messages for a room, sorted oldest-first.

Valid room slugs: general | options-trading | crypto-analysis | dividend-investing

Expected response: [{ _id, userId, userName, content, room, timestamp, parentId }]

Note: Sending messages is done via Socket.IO send_message event — not REST.

item.name: Health
item.description: Server health check — no auth required.

request.description:
Confirms the Express server and MongoDB connection are alive.

Expected response: { status: 'ok', db: 'connected', uptime: <seconds> }
